title: Nicole Kidman
headline: Nicole Kidman can't remember half the films in Adéla's video
caption:
"I can't believe it, she wrote a song called Nicole Kidman." That was Nicole Kidman on The Tonight Show, talking about Adéla's "Nicole Kidman".

She'd known about it since August. Adéla put the track list for Prima out on 25 August, and the very next day Kidman was asked about the song at the Practical Magic 2 premiere. She said she meant to catch Adéla's Red Bottoms Tour in Nashville on 21 September.

By the time she sat down with Fallon she'd seen the video too. In it, she said, Adéla "did all the films I've done." Then she called her "so talented."

🎧 The song: "Nicole Kidman" by Adéla (@adelajergova)

Source: Wikipedia, including Nicole Kidman on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon

comment: About the song, it samples "In My Father's House" by God's Gospel Angels, from the 1986 album Praise Him.
